create_to_pickle: create to_pickle to serialize a pandas DataFrame and save it to a file path
test_to_pickle: test to_pickle with compression options and custom pickle protocol on a pandas object
create_read_pickle: create read_pickle to load a pickled pandas DataFrame or Series from a file path
test_read_pickle: test read_pickle with compression inference and storage options for remote URLs
summarize_pickle_compat: summarize how read_pickle falls back to pickle_compat.Unpickler for older pandas serialized objects
